text: Program Description Trains the student to grasp the basic principle of marxist philosophy and ethics, ethical foundation to master Chinese and foreign theories, through the aspects of philosophy and ethics of professional training, master system basic knowledge and professional knowledge. To train students to have strong theoretical thinking, problem analysis, problem solving and language skills. Cultivate excellent, having both ability and political integrity, meet the needs of modernization construction in China, has a wide range of scientific and cultural knowledge base and philosophy accomplishment, strong ability of theoretical thinking philosophy, ethics and practical work ability, talent for the ethics of professional talents in the new century and universality. Duration 3 years
